source.behavior: Reset to page 1 and perform tenant-authorized GET of synchronized WordPress posts with search/site/status/page size; clear current selection. Read-only filter; no WordPress mutation.

implementation.details: Draft filters are applied only on submit; filter revision forces a new authoritative read even with unchanged values. Tenant-scoped site filter, status, search of title/slug/body/excerpt, per-page, selection reset and error display.

security.tenant_isolation: Tenant context from authenticated middleware; ContentItem and Site global tenant scopes.
security.direct_site_id: Tenant-scoped Site::findOrFail rejects foreign tenant site IDs.
security.permission: content.view for GET; tenant.view for site option list; content.edit for existing mutations.
security.failure: HTTP errors displayed; no optimistic success, no WordPress mutation.

provenance.readiness: Pending exact-source registration, official seven-stage materialization and exact-head CI.
